item.title: Gospel Night with The Fabulous Highway QC's — Thu Nov 26, 9:00 PM — The Double Crown West Asheville
item.description:
The Fabulous Highway QC’s from Chicago return to The Double Crown Thanksgiving Thursday November 26th. 9 pm $10 The Fabulous Highway Q.C.’s, now known simply as The Highway Q.C.’s, are a highly influential Chicago-based gospel group founded in 1945. This group is famous for being a stepping stone for legendary artists like Sam Cooke, Lou Rawls, and Johnnie Taylor, who all sang with them before launching their own successful careers. The group continues to perform today, led by long-time member Spencer Taylor Jr., who passed away last September. The Double Crown – Great vibes, great bourbon, and great music! (21+ only, dog friendly) A West Asheville institution, the Double Crown hosts Western Wednesdays, karaoke, DJ’s and rousing Gospel & Soul night’s each month. It’s a great place for an intimate evening of dancing, drinks and fun, especially if you love a good dive bar.
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: World Affairs Council of Western North Carolina: The U.S.-UK Special Relationship — An Insider’s Take — Tue Dec 1, 7:00 PM
item.description: Drawing on her 34 years as an American diplomat, including more than a decade working directly in and on the United Kingdom, Ambassador Barbara Stephenson explores the history and current state of the U.S.-UK Special Relationship. She will discuss the countries’ close cooperation in intelligence, military, and diplomatic affairs, as well as longstanding and emerging points of tension. Through personal anecdotes and photographs from a state visit by the Obamas, Stephenson will offer behind-the-scenes insight into this important bilateral relationship. This event will take place in the Reuter Center and is free and open to the public. About the Speaker Barbara Stephenson is the William and Anne Harrison Vice Provost for Global Affairs and Chief Global Officer at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. Awakening Asheville Explore Your Inner Wisdom: A Personal QHHT Session
Join me for a private, in-person session near Nebo, NC, based on Dolores Cannon’s Quantum Healing Hypnosis Technique (QHHT).
This approximately three-hour session offers an opportunity to explore past-life experiences through guided hypnosis and connect with what this practice calls your Higher Self. Bring your curiosity, questions, and intentions as we explore insights that may support deeper self-understanding and personal reflection.
This appointment is reserved for one person. Sessions take place in my home, where we have friendly cats and a dog. Please let me know beforehand if you have allergies or concerns about animals. For an additional fee, I can also arrange to meet at your home or a mutually agreed-upon location.

item.title: 9:15 Contemplative Service — Sun Dec 6, 9:15 AM — *1 Sanctuary
item.description:
At 9:15 AM, we have a 40-45 minute Contemplative Worship Service. This service invites participants into a reflective, more meditative space, and includes silence, beautiful recorded music and videos, and opportunities for sharing. It also features the sermon and theme which will be the focus in the second service at 11:15 AM. This service is not livestreamed., and it include childcare but not a full religious education program. This service will be particularly good if you need quiet in order to hear well or focus, would prefer a little more space around you, or seek a more contemplative communal experience. Between services, at 10 am we will have coffee hour and special programs. Whether you come to the early service or the later service, we encourage you to consider arriving at 10 am for coffee, conversation, and special programs including conversations with the Board, or Minister & lay-led justice or adult education offerings.

item.title: Shut Up & Write!® - Downtown — Tue Dec 15, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina ***\*\*\*Please note: event listings are moving to the Shut Up & Write! website and this Meetup page will be closed in a few weeks. You will find our Tuesday night events here: [https://www.shutupwrite.com/series/id2uT2JS7l00](https://www.shutupwrite.com/series/id2uT2JS7l00)\*\*\****
**Here's how it works.** Show up at or before 6:00. At 6:00, we do some quick introductions. Afterward, for a full 60 minutes (I'll set a timer!) we are heads-down writing. Writing what? A novel? You bet. Some poetry? Sure. Song lyrics? Your resume? That report you need to get to your boss before 8 AM or you'll *need* *to write* that resume? All of the above and more. Just shut up and write.
Surrounding ourselves with other writers who are busy putting words onto page (physical or virtual) keeps us all accountable and focused.
When the timer goes off, we'll check-in with each other and see how it went. Afterward, feel free to stay to chat and get to know your fel

item.title: Fun & easy way to play more tennis (please read event description for details) — Tue Dec 15, 7:00 PM
item.description:
PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis We’re still working to get more people into these Meetups, but our goal is to give PlayYourCourt members a few social tennis outings each week in addition to your practice sessions and Challenge League matches.
These Meetups are co-ed, super laid back, and all skill levels are welcome. Post your skill level and a suggested court in the comments section so we can round up as many players as we can for some tennis fun!
Also, if you’re looking to meet new practice partners or play some matches and you aren’t already in the PlayYourCourt Community, you can go here to see what we’re all about and sign up:
https://www.playyourcourt.com/tennis-community/asheville-nc/meetup/
If you love tennis, we’d love to have you! Be sure and watch the quick video that explains how everything works.
Happy hitting!
- Scott
Source: PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis

Game Over is a celebration of the end of the year. Maybe your glad it's over or maybe it was your best one yet but we can all get together to laugh at some of the chaos of the last 365 days.
